XMLDB.COMMENT: Sign-up guard: the log of refused registration attempts and the IP deny list that feeds it.

TABLE.NAME: local_profilefields_log
TABLE.COMMENT: One row per registration attempt the location guard refused. No account exists for these rows - they are the record of accounts that were never created.

FIELD.NAME: ip
FIELD.COMMENT: The visitor's address as getremoteaddr() reported it. 45 chars covers IPv6.

FIELD.NAME: declared
FIELD.COMMENT: Alpha-2 country the visitor claimed (the phone field's country), or '' when the attempt never got that far.

FIELD.NAME: detected
FIELD.COMMENT: Alpha-2 country the geo-IP lookup resolved, or '' when it resolved nothing.

FIELD.NAME: origin
FIELD.COMMENT: signup|complete|app - which of the three registration entry points was refused.

TABLE.NAME: local_profilefields_ip
TABLE.COMMENT: The registration IP deny list. Each row is one entry in the format address_in_subnet() understands: a single address, a CIDR block, a partial address or a range.

FIELD.NAME: note
FIELD.COMMENT: Free-text note for whoever reads the list later.
